description: A contemporary residential entry facade photographed at dusk, camera at standing eye-level with a normal-to-wide lens capturing the full front entry in a centered symmetrical composition. Recessed landscape spots cast soft cones of uplighting on the plantings and around the base of the tree. The interior foyer glows warmly beyond the glass door. The twilight sky is a deep blue-gray.
